entries.authors: Rammal R, Toulouse G
entries.title: Random walks on fractal structures and percolation clusters
entries.role: 奠基：谱维数定义于自相似/分形结构
entries.note: 定义谱维数；Sierpinski 三角族谱维数按尺度参数导出；随机行走性质受谱维数控制

entries.authors: D'Auriac J C A, Benoît A, Rammal R
entries.title: Random walk on fractals: numerical studies in two dimensions
entries.venue: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and General
entries.role: 数值验证：Sierpinski 三角谱维数 d_s=2 ln(d+1)/ln(d+3)
entries.note: 二维 Sierpinski 三角上随机行走统计性质

entries.authors: Aharony A
entries.title: Fractals in physics
entries.role: 综述：谱维数(fracton) d_s=2D/(2+θ)；Alexander-Orbach 猜想 d_s=4/3
entries.note: 渗透集团上随机行走访问节点数随 N^{d_s/2} 标度

entries.authors: Millán A P, Gori G, Battiston F, Enss T, Defenu N
entries.title: Complex networks with tuneable spectral dimension as a universality playground
entries.role: 网络几何：可调谱维数网络模型(1→∞)，验证 P_0(t)~t^{-d_s/2}
entries.note: 连接概率按节点距离幂律；谱维数连续可调

entries.authors: Avrachenkov K, Cottatellucci L, Hamidouche M
entries.title: Eigenvalues and spectral dimension of random geometric graphs in thermodynamic regime
entries.role: 随机几何图谱维数≈空间维数 d
entries.note: 热力学区平均度恒定下 SD 由空间维数近似

entries.authors: Craig A, Yücel M, Muchnik L, Hershberg U
entries.title: Impact of finite size effect on applicability of generalized fractal and spectral dimensions to biological networks
entries.role: 裁判型：有限尺寸效应影响 fractal/spectral 维数估计；MBRW 谱维数估计
entries.note: 量化了有限尺寸对实证维数估计的偏差

entries.authors: Grimaldi L, Villegas P, Vezzani A, Burioni R, Cassi D, Gabrielli A
entries.title: Unveiling the dimensionality of networks of networks
entries.role: 裁判型：网络组成('tinkering')使 Fiedler 维数与谱维数解耦
entries.note: 介观(Fiedler 维数)与宏观(谱维数)集体动力学区分

entries.authors: Lacasa L, Gómez-Gardeñes J
entries.title: Correlation dimension of complex networks
entries.role: 方法：基于随机行走相关和的关联维数估计，规避 box-covering 缺陷
entries.note: 扩展 Grassberger-Procaccia 到网络

entries.authors: Yakubo K, Shimojo G, Yamamoto J
entries.title: Random walks on bifractal networks
entries.role: 裁判型：双分形网络上谱维数非唯一(hub vs 非 hub 起点 d_s^min/d_s^max)
entries.note: walk 维数恒定，局部 spectral 维数双值

entries.authors: Mülken O, Heinzelmann S, Dolgushev M
entries.title: Information dimension of stochastic processes on networks: relating entropy production to spectral properties
entries.role: 熵增与谱密度标度关系；(Information) spectral dimension
entries.note: SG 上主方程解为 stretched exponential，谱维数 d_s=2 ln 3/ln 2

entries.authors: Haynes C P, Roberts A P
entries.title: Global first passage times on fractal lattices
entries.role: 首达时间方差 Var(T) ~ N^{4/d_s}
entries.note: 五个分形上的全局首达时间表达式

entries.authors: Zhang Z, Yang Y, Gao S
entries.title: Role of fractal dimension in random walks on scale-free networks
entries.role: trapping 效率与分形维数关系（对照谱维数）
entries.note: (x,y)-flower 与混合网络平均 trapping 时间解析

entries.authors: Tejedor V, Bénichou O, Voituriez R
entries.title: Global mean first-passage times of random walks on complex networks
entries.role: GMFPT 下界与 transient 判据（目标相关）
entries.note: 与 small-world/scale-free/fractal 无关的普适下界

entries.authors: Millán A P, Torres J J, Bianconi G
entries.title: Synchronization in network geometries with finite spectral dimension
entries.role: 核心裁决：d_s>4 同步热力学稳定；d_s>2 相位锁定
entries.note: 复杂网络流形上 Kuramoto 模型，谱维数可调

entries.authors: Millán A P, Torres J J, Bianconi G
entries.title: Complex network geometry and frustrated synchronization
entries.role: 复杂网络流形上 frustrated 同步受谱维数影响
entries.note: 小世界+高模块结构+有限谱维数

entries.authors: Patterson S, Bamieh B
entries.title: Consensus and coherence in fractal networks
entries.venue: IEEE Transactions on Control of Network Systems
entries.role: 核心裁决：同分形维数可不同相干性；H~N^{2/d_s-1}，且谱维数<2 消解矛盾
entries.note: 一级 H_FO~N^{2/d_s-1}，二级 H_SO~N^{4/d_s-1}；分数维不唯一决定相干性

entries.authors: Qi Y, Yi Y, Zhang Z, Li H
entries.title: Consensus in self-similar hierarchical graphs and Sierpiński graphs: convergence speed, delay robustness, and coherence
entries.role: 分形(Sierpiński)图上共识收敛/延迟/相干性解析对比
entries.note: 分层图vs Sierpiński 图：收敛速度、延迟鲁棒性、相干性

entries.authors: Jin Z, Murray R M
entries.title: Random consensus protocol in large-scale networks
entries.venue: IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
entries.role: 奠基：代数连通性 λ_2 控制连续时间共识速度；正则格子 λ_2→0
entries.note: λ_2(代数连通性)决定收敛速度上界

entries.authors: Gómez-Gardeñes J, Moreno Y, Pérez-Vicente C J, Gómez S, Díaz-Guilera A, Arenas A
entries.title: Diffusion dynamics on multiplex networks
entries.role: 谱分析连接扩散/同步时间与 λ_2
entries.note: 多层网络扩散动力学谱结构

entries.authors: Schennach S M
entries.title: Long memory via networking
entries.role: 跨学科：网络几何谱维数刻画长记忆；d_s 不唯一由度分布决定
entries.note: 随机行走 c_n ~ n^{-d_s/2} 关联长记忆

entries.authors: Mitrović Dankulov M, Tadić B, Melnik R
entries.title: Spectral properties of hyperbolic nanonetworks with tunable aggregation of simplexes
entries.role: 构造 d_s>4 的自组装超分子网络；同步动态相变与 d_s 关系
entries.note: 通过控制高阶连通性可达 d_s>4

entries.authors: Evnin O
entries.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking on graphs and lattices
entries.role: 理论：连续对称自发破缺由谱维数 d_s 控制(类似 Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner)
entries.note: 把同步/序参量相变与谱维数统一

entries.authors: Zhang Z, Zhou S, Xie W, Chen L, Lin Y, Guan J
entries.title: Standard random walks and trapping on the Koch network with scale-free behavior and small-world effect
entries.role: scale-free 小世界网络(Koch)trapping 标度；与分形网络对照
entries.note: MFPT 线性于 N；分形/谱维数对比维度
